title: Resin/HM20 Embedding and fMOST Imaging Protocol
author: Hui Gong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssgeebw
materials: Protocol for Resin/ HM20 embedding and fMOST imaging
Author：Hui Gong, Xiangning Li, Can Zhou
Huazhong University of Science and Technology（HUST）
Principal Investigators – Qingming Luo and Hui Gong
List of reagents required for the experiment
Prepare 50, 75, and 95% (vol/vol) graded ethanol solutions in distilled water. For example, for 50% ethanol solutions, add 1 volume absolute ethanol to 1 volume distilled water in a centrifuge tube

Prepare 50% and 75% (wt/wt) graded resin solutions in absolute ethanol. For example, for 50% resin solutions, add 1 weight absolute ethanol to 1 weight resin working solution in a brown glass bottle, and stored at 4 ° C
Upload the data after the data acquisition.

steps.title: Prepare Glass Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the glass column for resin filling.

substeps.instruction: Add Al2O3 powder to a clean glass column.
Slowly pour monomer E solution or cross-linker D of Lowicryl HM20® resin into the column while slowly introducing nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare PBS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.01M PBS buffer solution and pre-cool it to 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse Mouse Brain
steps.instruction: Rinse the mouse brain in a 50 ml centrifuge tube using pre-cooled PBS solution at 4 °C in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 3 times for durations of 2h, 2h, and 12h.

steps.title: Dehydrate Mouse Brain
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the mouse brain in a 50 ml centrifuge tube at 4 °C in the dark using a graded ethanol series.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate in 50% ethanol for 1 hour.
Dehydrate in 75% ethanol for 2 hours.
Dehydrate in 95% ethanol for 2 hours.
Dehydrate in absolute ethanol 3 times for 2 hours each time.

steps.title: Prepare Resin Working Solution
steps.instruction: Create the resin working solution in a 60ml brown glass bottle.

substeps.instruction: Combine 0.048g AIBN crystal particles, 5.25g crosslink D, and 24.75g monomer E solution.
Slowly stir on a magnetic stirrer for 5-10 minutes until AIBN crystals are completely dissolved.
Store the solution at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Aliquot Resin Solution
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared resin working solution into 3 brown glass bottles (5 g each) and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pre-permeate Mouse Brain
steps.instruction: Pre-permeate the dehydrated mouse brain at 4 °C in the dark using graded resin solutions.

substeps.instruction: Permeate for 2 hours in 50% resin solution.
Permeate for 2 hours in 75% resin solution.

steps.title: Infiltrate Mouse Brain
steps.instruction: Transfer the pre-permeated mouse brain to the 3 brown glass bottles containing resin working solution.

substeps.instruction: Infiltrate for 2 h and then 24 h at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare CR-quench Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the CR-quench solution by pipetting 5 g resin working solution into a brown glass bottle and adding acetic acid.

substeps.instruction: Store the solution at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Quench Infiltrated Brain
steps.instruction: Transfer the infiltrated mouse brain to the CR-quench solution and store at 4 °C for 14 h in the dark.

steps.title: Embed Brain in Capsule
steps.instruction: Position the brain in a 000# capsule on the sample holder.

substeps.instruction: Place the opened 000# capsule on the capsule hole of the sample holder.
Position the brain so the olfactory bulb faces downward and the ventral side is slightly tilted, ensuring the olfactory bulb is centered and the brain is nearly perpendicular to the capsule bottom.

steps.title: Polymerize Sample
steps.instruction: Polymerize the resin in a vacuum drying oven.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 1 ml resin to the capsule.
Heat at 37 °C for 20 hours.
Heat at 50 °C for 4 hours to complete polymerization.

steps.title: Extract and Mount Sample
steps.instruction: Remove the sample from the oven and mount it for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the oven, open the intake valve and oven door, and remove the sample.
Fix the sample with the sample holder and install the holder into the sample cell.

steps.title: Prepare Immersion Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare an immersion solution consisting of 0.05mol/L sodium carbonate with 1 ug/ml propidium iodide in PBS.

steps.title: Perform fMOST Imaging
steps.instruction: Image the sample using the BioMapping 5000 (fMOST) instrument.

substeps.instruction: Align the diamond knife with the sample.
Add the immersion solution to the sample cell to completely immerse the sample.
Cut the sample surface to make it flat.
Run the data acquisition program with the appointed parameters.
